types.name: License & Permit Bond
types.description: Required by government agencies to obtain a business license or permit. Guarantees compliance with regulations.
types.examples: Contractor license, auto dealer, collection agency, money transmitter

types.name: Contractor Bond
types.description: Required in most states for general contractors and specialty trades. Protects project owners from contractor non-performance.
types.examples: General contractor, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, roofing

types.name: Mortgage Broker Bond
types.description: Required by state and federal regulators (NMLS) for mortgage lenders, brokers, and servicers.
types.examples: Mortgage lender, mortgage broker, loan servicer

types.name: Money Transmitter Bond
types.description: Required in most states for businesses that transfer money on behalf of others. Bond amounts are among the highest of any license type.
types.examples: Payment processors, digital wallets, prepaid cards, cryptocurrency exchanges

types.name: Auto Dealer Bond
types.description: Required in all 50 states for motor vehicle dealers. Protects consumers against dealer fraud or misrepresentation.
types.examples: New car dealer, used car dealer, wholesale dealer, motorcycle dealer

types.name: Collection Agency Bond
types.description: Required in most states for debt collectors and collection agencies. Guarantees ethical collection practices.
types.examples: Third-party collectors, debt buyers, repossession agencies

types.name: Freight Broker Bond (BMC-84)
types.description: Required by the FMCSA for all licensed freight brokers. Fixed at $75,000 bond amount.
types.examples: Freight brokers, freight forwarders, property brokers

types.name: Court / Judicial Bond
types.description: Required by courts in legal proceedings. Includes appeal bonds, attachment bonds, and injunction bonds.
types.examples: Appeal bonds, injunction bonds, attachment bonds, supersedeas bonds

types.name: Fidelity Bond
types.description: Protects businesses against employee theft, fraud, or dishonesty. Often required by clients or contracts.
types.examples: Janitorial services, home health aides, property managers, financial services

types.name: Performance Bond
types.description: Guarantees completion of a construction project. Required on government projects and many large private projects.
types.examples: Government construction, infrastructure, large commercial projects
